reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: The barcode function works (earning the one star) but the spam and popups to get you to subscribe is abysmal UX. Hiding the x using color matching to the background image is disgusting, anti-consumeristic and downright delete-worthy. Find one of the million other apps that can translate a barcode to text on the App Store that won’t harass you.
